class.name: PathExtrudeProfileRect
class.brief_description: A resource to define a rectangular extrusion profile for [PathExtrude3D].
class.description: This resource defines a rectangular profile for [PathExtrude3D]. It can generate a flat end cap or an arrow end cap with independently configurable cross-section dimensions and depth.

members.member: Additional height of the flare cross section beyond the base rectangle.
Distance along +Z from the base rectangle to the flare cross section.
Additional width of the flare cross section beyond the base rectangle.
Height of the arrow tip cross section. Set to zero for a line or point tip.
Additional distance along +Z from the flare cross section to the arrow tip.
Width of the arrow tip cross section. Set to zero for a line or point tip.
Selects a flat cap or an arrow cap. Arrow-only properties are hidden when flat mode is selected.
If [code]true[/code], the normals of the rectangle will be smoothed.
The number of times in width (x) and height (y) to divide the square for better twisting.
